scope: Proposition 5.3 (Sliced estimates) of the manuscript “Quantitative Near-Kerr Evolution and Generic C2 Future Inextendibility” (preprints/Quantitative-Near-Kerr-Evolution-and-Generic-C2-Future-Inextendibility-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 264 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 cd38cc55e3c203a3), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 48. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: On any fixed enlarged compact reach, the simultaneous budgets imply Sa ≤ C(R0)KR + CF + Cfix(ein + N2 ), C independent of R0, (5.16) ∥gco − Gp,c∥L2 AS H8 loc ≤ Cloc(KR + F + Sa) + Cfix(ein + N2 ). (5.17) The second estimate includes mixed jets of total order eight, and one extra time derivative with the same mixed order on fixed sets outside the physical trapping neighborhood. This extra derivative will supply the mixed time-radial trace in (7.11) when the exterior solution is restricted to the interior entry cylinder. Constants on these fixed reaches are independent of the upper radius R.
